purpose: Cross answer-content controls with prompt examples; no accuracy claims.
design: 48 selected reused cases x4 answer conditions x4 prompt conditions

expectations.empty: all dimension scores0 and overall unhelpful
expectations.generic: no substantive assistance; all scores0 and overall unhelpful
expectations.swapped: exploratory only; donor answers may accidentally help, not gold negatives

interpretation: Balanced versus absent examples changes content and length; reverse order isolates order within the same example set. Neither high scores nor agreement selects a winner. Sample is outcome-stratified, not prevalence representative. No partial deletions or invented complete answers without case review.
next: Review actual disagreement cases and freeze measurement protocol before linking intent and helpfulness.
